regions.merged_text: Surely it is a promisin turn in the outlook for a five- year paralytic. Their fraternal-Christian interest as shown in response to the Chaplain's appeal for a so helpless sister-Mrs. Mary O.D., is surely to the high credit of the Boys in Cap (at the Gross Ille Base") . If every one of Mary's friends do what they can to please God and to sanctify their own souls, God in His merciful wisdom and power will give them the surprise of their life.
